audit_items.proof_trace: The implementation correctly ensures unique proposer seeds by appending distinct slot numbers (slot+i for i in [0, SlotsPerEpoch)) to the base epoch seed before hashing. Mathematical uniqueness: for i≠j, slot+i≠slot+j, thus hash(seed||slot+i)≠hash(seed||slot+j) with overwhelming probability given SHA256's collision resistance. No state mutation occurs as append(seed[:], ...) creates new slices each iteration.
